title: Indian Medical Association v. V.P. Shantha

content.caseIdentity: Indian Medical Association v. V.P. Shantha, (1995) 6 SCC 651 (Supreme Court of India)
content.holding: Held that medical services rendered by medical practitioners and hospitals for consideration fall within the definition of "service". Patients can claim compensation for medical negligence before Consumer Forums.
content.relevance: Brought the medical profession and healthcare institutions within the regulatory oversight of consumer law.
